items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Tell me his brother was one of the greatest biotone players. It was George.

ctx.x: Yes, we've heard people up at Donaldsonville.
Yeah, and his brother... Tell me his brother was one of the greatest biotone players. It was George. George, that's right.
He played trombone too, didn't he?
